description: Defines a template class 'FastVector' which implements a vector with a fixed initial size and dynamic growth, based on 'FixedVector'. Includes methods for vector operations, memory management, and comparison operators.

classes.name: FastVector
classes.description: A vector class with initial fixed size and variable growth, supporting typical vector operations.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the vector to a specified size, optionally filling new elements with a value.

methods.name: remove_and_permute
methods.description: Removes a specific element and permutes the list to fill the gap.
